For growing logistics businesses, managing capital is often a balancing act. When freight demands increase or route expansions become necessary, adding vehicles to your lineup can be an important step. However, purchasing brand-new commercial trucks can often strain an operating budget. This is where pre-auction pricing presents a unique opportunity for South Florida operations. By leveraging “as-is” units, fleet managers and owner-operators can scale their capabilities effectively while aiming to keep acquisition costs under $20,000. At Rechtien International Trucks, we offer a strategic selection of reliable, trade-in, and pre-auction commercial trucks. With prices often starting at just $17,000, you can secure the equipment you need without compromising your financial flexibility.
The Strategic Budget Play: Why Choose “As-Is” Units?

Purchasing “as-is” commercial trucks is widely regarded as a savvy budget play for companies looking to expand their hauling capacity quickly. Instead of sending older but capable trade-in vehicles directly to the auction block, dealerships can offer them to the public at deeply discounted rates.

With a pre-auction unit, you can take control of the maintenance schedule, addressing specific maintenance needs to ensure your vehicle meets strict DOT compliance and road-safety standards.
Localized Solutions: Hauling from PortMiami to the Caloosahatchee River

South Florida’s logistics landscape is diverse, requiring different vehicle capabilities depending on where your routes take you. Rechtien International Trucks operates five convenient locations across the region, which can make it easier to find the right under-$20k truck near your home base.
Miami and Ft. Lauderdale: Navigating Busy Ports and Interstates

If your routes primarily involve pulling chassis from PortMiami or navigating the tight, high-traffic corridors around Port Everglades and the I-95 express lanes, a cost-effective day cab could be an ideal addition to your fleet. An as-is unit can allow you to handle local drayage operations and city deliveries near downtown Miami and Ft. Lauderdale without the high overhead of a new truck.
Riviera Beach and Ft. Pierce: Expanding Along the Treasure Coast

For operations moving freight out of the Port of Palm Beach in Riviera Beach or hauling agricultural and construction supplies through Ft. Pierce, durability is key. Our locations along the Treasure Coast and South Florida’s eastern seaboard provide convenient access to pre-auction inventory. Whether you need a medium-duty box truck or a heavy-duty tractor to run routes along Florida’s Turnpike, our $17,000 starting price point can help you expand your reach without overextending your credit line.
Ft. Myers: Driving Growth in Southwest Florida

On the Gulf Coast, the logistics demands are just as active. If your business transports materials over the Caloosahatchee River or frequently utilizes the I-75 corridor near Southwest Florida International Airport, stopping by our Ft. Myers location can connect you with budget-friendly fleet additions. An as-is commercial truck can provide the flexibility to capitalize on new contracts in this rapidly growing region.
Maximizing Your ROI with Pre-Auction Commercial Trucks

When you scale your fleet for under $20,000, the potential return on investment (ROI) can be substantial. Lower upfront acquisition costs often lead to faster break-even points on your new routes. Because you are buying the vehicle before it goes to the public auction, you can often avoid paying the standard auction buyer premiums and bidding fees. The $17,000 starting price can allow you to factor in any necessary refurbishments or cosmetic touch-ups while still staying well below the standard cost of a retail-ready used truck.
